resources.string: Bring a WireGuard configuration from a provider or server you trust. Importing stores it on this device, encrypted with Android Keystore. It does not connect you. Android VPN consent is only requested when a real tunnel is ready to start.
Android will ask for VPN consent the first time. The tunnel uses only the WireGuard configuration you imported.
No active tunnel. Connect from Home to see measured session details.
Connected since this app process started.
Configuration stored on this device. These values are not protection claims.
Android reports no active VPN network. This is expected while the tunnel is down.
Traffic counters are reported by the WireGuard backend on this device.
No configuration is selected. Import or select a WireGuard configuration first.
Android VPN consent was not granted. No tunnel was started.
The saved configuration could not be read. Retry from My Servers.
The saved configuration is not valid for the WireGuard backend. Re-import it.
Android did not authorize the VPN service. Connect again and approve the system prompt.
The WireGuard backend could not start the tunnel. The error was not hidden; check the configuration and try again.
The backend did not confirm shutdown. The tunnel may still be active; try Disconnect again or check Android VPN settings.
The tunnel stopped unexpectedly. Counters are no longer updating.
Import your own WireGuard configuration. No server fleet, latency or protection is assumed.
Use a unique name, up to 48 characters.

Private keys are encrypted on this device and excluded from backup. Clipboard is read only when you tap Paste. A maximum of 64 KiB and 20 profiles is supported. QR import reads a selected image; live camera scanning is not enabled yet.
This removes only this configuration from encrypted KX storage. It does not revoke the peer on your server. This cannot be undone.
Check the name and configuration. A unique name and valid WireGuard keys, interface address, peer endpoint and allowed routes are required.
Could not read this input. Choose a valid configuration file or QR image, or paste plain text.
Saved configurations could not be opened. Existing data has been preserved. Retry; do not overwrite it.
The operation could not be saved. Existing data has been preserved.
Local device · no account or premium subscription is configured

Measured with Android StatFs on the internal data volume. Cache count covers KX only. Other apps’ private data is inaccessible. Media categorization and folder scanning are not enabled yet; no files are deleted by this screen.
Notifications: unavailable in this build. No notification permission is declared, so KX never posts alerts.
Language and theme go back to system defaults.
Privacy: profiles are encrypted with the Android Keystore and excluded from backup. No account or subscription is configured. No analytics or network calls are made by this screen.
Diagnose first. Act safely. Verify the outcome.
This action measures only the internal volume with Android StatFs, the KX-owned cache, and the KX repair journal. Private storage of other apps is inaccessible and is never reported.
Measurement failed. No values are shown that were not read from Android.
%1$s used on this volume, including data Android does not expose to KX
The first 500 KX cache files are listed. The byte total covers the whole KX cache.
%1$d KX cache files · %2$s measured. Nothing is removed from this dashboard.

The KX cache preview failed, so no cleanup claim is made.
No repair operations recorded yet. Completed Cache Surgeon removals appear here with measured results.
Only KX-owned data and Android measurements are used. Private storage of other apps is never read. This dashboard never deletes files.
This service is not implemented yet. KX shows no simulated results, estimates or progress for it.
internal volume and KX cache measured with Android APIs

KX profiles, preferences, and diagnostic records under your control.

Volume unavailable, so reconciliation is not shown.
Used space includes other apps and the system. MediaStore and folder totals may overlap when the chosen folder is also indexed by MediaStore.
Read-only MediaStore totals. KX never modifies or uploads media.
Media permission is required for image, video and audio totals.
Media access was denied. You can grant it in Android settings.
The MediaStore query stopped at 200,000 rows; totals cover the returned rows only.

Document totals via MediaStore are not queried on this Android version. Use the folder scan below.
Scope: internal volume via StatFs, MediaStore rows the system returns, and the SAF tree you choose. Other apps’ private storage is inaccessible.
Storage X-Ray is read-only. It never deletes or moves files.
